description: The chart represents the distribution of different character categories. The chart is divided into 11 slices, with the largest slice being "Game Characters" (light blue, approximately 30%), followed by "Novel Characters" (light blue, around 15%), "Teleplay Characters" (light blue, about 10%), and "Movie Characters" (light blue, roughly 10%), all grouped under "Virtual Characters" (blue, approximately 65%). The "Real Characters" category (green, around 30%) is further divided into "Influencers" (light green, about 5%), "Actors" (light green, roughly 5%), "Musicians" (light green, approximately 4%), "Writers" (light green, around 3%), "Athletes" (light green, about 3%), "Artists" (light green, roughly 3%), and "Scientists" (pink, approximately 7%), with "Custom Characters" (red, around 5%) being a separate category. The chart does not include a legend, but labels are provided inside or next to each slice, and the slices are visually grouped by color, with the "Virtual Characters" and "Real Characters" categories being distinct. The segments appear to be ordered in a hierarchical manner, with the larger categories containing smaller subcategories.
